column1: # The load addresses used to link applications — W-121.
# An application is linked outside the supervisor's gigabyte (0x8000_0000).
# It does not know its own load address (A1), and these addresses are what the
# tooling (the VSCode extension, check-roundtrip.sh) and the tests
# The first address is the primary one used by the tools.
# The second address is used by tests to prove position independence.
